hero.name: Rariana Aina Andriamiadana
hero.subtitle: I design and build websites and web applications end to end for clients in France and worldwide: .NET and Java on the server, React and TypeScript on the front end, Supabase and Odoo when the project calls for it. Available for remote work.

about.title: About me
about.subtitle: From business need to live application
about.description_1: As a freelance full stack developer, I build websites and web applications remotely for clients in France, such as the Harrys Studio booking site or the redesign of the Agentova.ai website. I also support five companies as an Odoo consultant. I cover the whole chain: requirements, data model, interface, go-live and ongoing updates.
about.description_2: At OPTIMADA, I evolved an HR application used by companies of 300 to 2,000 employees and took part in its migration to .NET and React, then built a customer portal in Spring Boot and React synchronized with Sage 100cloud CRM. At KASIA Consulting, I configured Odoo and developed custom modules in Python.
about.description_3: Before development, I spent two years at Webhelp auditing user accounts and information system access for about 500 employees. I kept the rigor, the service mindset and the habit of working to international clients' requirements.

mobi-stock.name: Mobi Stock
mobi-stock.description: Offline management for phone and computer shops: IMEI tracking (Luhn check, uniqueness across the network), point of sale, purchasing with cost allocation, shop-to-shop transfers, Excel import, reports and synchronization between shops. Desktop application with business logic tested on SQLite.

caisse.description: Offline-first point of sale, synchronized when the connection returns: multi-company, multi-shop, multi-register, printed receipts, web back office and signed licences verified offline.

shots.booking: Booking: availability calendar and the day's free time slots.

agentova.name: Agentova.ai

live-erp.description: ERP for live-stream selling on Facebook and TikTok: suppliers, purchasing, item-by-item checks, live console, parcel preparation, couriers, returns and reports. RLS security tested in SQL, continuous integration and a Tauri desktop build.

fotoanako.name: Fotoanako
fotoanako.description: White-label online booking for salons, spas or tattoo studios: storefront, booking, admin, loyalty and automated emails. Redeployable for each client through business presets.

shots.home: Demo storefront under a generic brand.
